title: Kubernetes & OKD
subtitle: Declarative container orchestration that reconciles desired state continuously.

tiles.label: API server
tiles.says: The API server is the single front door for state.
tiles.detail: Every client and component authenticates here. Uniform access and RBAC make the platform governable.

tiles.label: etcd
tiles.says: etcd stores cluster state with quorum consistency.
tiles.detail: A Raft-based key-value store keeps desired and observed state. Backups of it are the foundation of disaster recovery.

tiles.label: Controllers
tiles.says: Controllers compare desired and actual state, then act.
tiles.detail: Deployments, ReplicaSets and nodes each have a loop. Self-healing and rollouts come from reconciliation, not scripts.

tiles.label: Scheduler
tiles.says: The scheduler places pods using requests, affinity and taints.
tiles.detail: Resource-aware placement packs nodes efficiently and spreads replicas across failure domains.

tiles.label: kubelet
tiles.says: The kubelet runs pods and reports their health.
tiles.detail: It starts containers through the runtime, executes probes and restarts what fails.

tiles.label: Deployments
tiles.says: Deployments roll out new versions gradually and roll back.
tiles.detail: Rolling updates with readiness gates reduce release risk and shorten recovery from bad changes.

tiles.label: Services
tiles.says: Services give pods a stable name and virtual IP.
tiles.detail: Label selectors track ready endpoints, so clients never chase changing pod addresses.

tiles.label: Route & Ingress
tiles.says: Routes and Ingress expose HTTP services externally.
tiles.detail: OKD routes are served by an HAProxy-based router; Ingress offers the portable equivalent with host and path rules.

tiles.label: RBAC & quotas
tiles.says: RBAC and quotas bound who can do what.
tiles.detail: Roles, namespaces and resource quotas allow safe multi-team sharing of one cluster.

declarations: Declare desired state, never perform steps.
The API server is the only door to etcd.
Readiness gates decide who gets traffic.
